answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The velvet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. A basalt of per-task receipts records who did what, and the river of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
